newsitem.title: USA: Mexico coffee areas seen cold again Fri, Sat - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Mexico coffee areas seen cold again Fri, Sat - WSC.

text.p: Mexico's coffee areas will again see fair and cold weather on Friday, with widely scattered showers in the far south and southeast, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said.

Low temperatures on Friday and Saturday mornings will drop into the mid and upper 30s F in the major coffee areas of Veracruz and Puebla, and will be near freezing in minor areas in higher elevations and in the north.
The high-elevation coffee areas of the northern belt may see some damage, but little damage is expected in the main belt at lower elevations, WSC said.

Temperatures will be below to well below normal, though the outlook is for fair and cool weather on Sunday, then milder conditions by Monday and Tuesday with a few scattered light showers in the south.
It was mostly dry in Mexico on Thursday with isolated showers to 0.75 inch in the south. Highs were 39-93 F from the northwest to the southeast.
